individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample measurement (n=141); marginal histograms show distributions, not averages requiring point overlay.
Scatter plot with each marker representing a cell line/reporter mean plus error bars for spread; scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Line/density distribution plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Box plot (exempt by type) that additionally overlays individual sample data points as dots.
Polar histograms show probability distributions of phase differences, not simple averages with error, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Polar histogram depicting a normalized distribution averaged by subtype; distribution-type plot exempt from individual point overlay requirement.
Example line plot illustrating a model fit, not a summary/average plot requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample (n=117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - no error bars present, individual measurements and histograms only.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]). n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - error bars defined as mean +/- s.d. with sample sizes specified.
not needed - density curves shown without error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - box plot elements (percentiles, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
not needed - polar histograms show normalized probability, no error bars depicted.
not needed - polar histogram shows normalized averages without error bars.
not needed - schematic example plot with no error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - error bars explicitly defined as standard deviation of fitted parameters.
